task: Predict APC mutation status in colon adenocarcinoma. Classes: negative vs. positive. Helpful H&E cues include conventional gland-forming adenocarcinoma architecture, dirty necrosis, and infiltrative tubular or cribriform growth often seen in APC-altered colorectal tumors.

classes.0: APC-negative colon adenocarcinoma lacking the strongest conventional gland-forming colorectal phenotype.
classes.1: APC-positive colon adenocarcinoma with conventional glandular, tubular, or cribriform architecture and typical dirty necrosis.
